objective: Test whether JANUS can distinguish semantic sufficiency from representation size and demonstrate a finite exact representation-language escape on Hidden Weighted Bit without allowing auxiliary variables or language switching to hide interface complexity.
research_law: EXACT_QUOTIENT_EXISTS does not imply SMALL_REPRESENTATION_EXISTS does not imply SMALL_REPRESENTATION_IS_FINDABLE does not imply SMALL_REPRESENTATION_IS_CHEAP_TO_UPDATE_OR_TRANSLATE.

R2A_ALL_ORDER_OBDD_KILL.definition: HWB_n(x)=x_s where s=sum_i x_i and x_0=0
R2A_ALL_ORDER_OBDD_KILL.measurement: minimum, median and maximum reduced OBDD node count across all orders; exact semantics checked against HWB truth table
R2A_ALL_ORDER_OBDD_KILL.external_reference: Graph driven BDDs — a new data structure for Boolean functions, TCS 141 (1995), reports exponential OBDD size for HWB for any variable ordering.
R2A_ALL_ORDER_OBDD_KILL.verdict_rule: Finite enumeration may say FINITE_ALL_ORDER_SURVIVOR/KILL only; the published theorem may be cited separately but is not converted into a JANUS proof receipt.

R2B_SDD_ESCAPE.language: uncompressed SDD-style partition certificate for HWB
R2B_SDD_ESCAPE.construction: Partition assignments into P0, Pn and Pi,0/Pi,1 by Hamming weight i and selected bit xi; each prime is represented by an exact reduced OBDD/cardinality component and paired with constant sub false/true as in the published HWB SDD construction.
required_checks: truth equivalence to HWB on all 2^n assignments
record explicit representation size and construction work
R2B_SDD_ESCAPE.claim_boundary: Finite exact escape plus literature-consistent polynomial construction signature; no universal JANUS complexity theorem.

PROJECTED_SEMANTICS_HARDNESS_GUARD.rule: If a polynomial-size Tseitin/circuit CNF F(x,z) is used, target semantics is f(x)=EXISTS z F(x,z). Representation cost claims about K_FUTURE are evaluated on the projected x-interface; internal auxiliary state is separately charged and cannot serve as free semantic compression.

TOTAL_CERTIFIED_REPRESENTATION_COST.formula: C_L(S)=payload_size + T_detect + T_choose_language + T_choose_structure + T_compile + T_update + T_translate + T_verify
TOTAL_CERTIFIED_REPRESENTATION_COST.rule: Node count alone cannot win a gate. R2A/B record only the components actually exercised; missing discovery/switching components remain OPEN rather than zero.

staged_successors.R2C: DISCOVERY_ATTACK__remove oracle knowledge of HWB and require JANUS to choose language/structure from opaque frozen typed input
staged_successors.R2D: CROSS_LANGUAGE_CONGRUENCE__every L_i to L_j transition requires exact equivalence certificate
staged_successors.R2E: PORTFOLIO_MONSTER__attack cumulative switching/compile cost even when every snapshot representation is small

gates.G1_HWB_TRUTH: all generated truth tables match definition
gates.G2_ALL_ORDER_FINITE: all variable orders enumerated exactly for n<=8 and all OBDDs truth-equivalent
gates.G3_SDD_CERT_SOUND: SDD-style partition certificate has zero semantic mismatches through n<=12
gates.G4_SDD_NONTRIVIAL_ESCAPE: for at least one n, SDD-style certificate size is smaller than the worst and best-enumerated OBDD size trend enough to demonstrate a language-dependent finite escape; no asymptotic claim is inferred from this gate
gates.G5_PROJECTED_SEMANTICS_GUARD: all reported semantic sizes are indexed to frozen interface variables; auxiliary variables never reduce measured interface semantics for free
gates.G6_COST_ACCOUNTING: representation bytes/nodes and construction/evaluation work are explicitly nonzero and missing discovery/switch costs are marked OPEN_NOT_MEASURED
gates.G7_SCIENTIFIC_BOUNDARY: P_VS_NP remains OPEN and R2A/B cannot emit FORMALLY_CERTIFIED universal portfolio lemma

journal_rule: Store prereg, raw rows, first mismatch if any, representation-size curve, cost ledger, post-result lessons, dead paths, external theorem refs and next allowed gate append-only.
